description:
Leonardo da Vinci's anatomical drawings: the skull, the fetus in the womb, muscles, the heart, the Vitruvian Man. Real public-domain works from open-access collections, each with title, date, medium, holding institution, credit, licence, source page and full-resolution link; the first comes back as an image.

Example questions:
- "Show me Leonardo's anatomy drawings"
- "Da Vinci skull drawing"
- "Leonardo's drawing of the fetus"

limit.description: How many works to list (1-10, default 5).

narrow.description: Optional extra words to narrow the theme (a place, year or motif).

name: leonardo_anatomy_drawings
title: Anatomy Drawings (Leonardo da Vinci)
